title: Hyperparameter tuning protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Hyperparameter tuning should complete this objective: Use grid and randomized search. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Improve model configuration.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Keep a final holdout set untouched and record the search budget.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV, best_params_ and does not run the learner code. Keep a final holdout set untouched and record the search budget.
